map.污染扩散按风向定受体。: Pollutant dispersion receptors by wind direction.
map.：「北风」指从北吹来（去向南），污染源在北侧时下风向（南）受体浓度高，布点看去向: : 'North wind' means blowing from the north (toward south); if the source is north, the downwind (south) receptor is higher—place stations by where it goes.
map.风向是来向还是去向？: Is wind direction from or to?
map.气象风向指「来向」（北风从北来）；但风羽箭头常画去向，读图注意区分。: Meteorological wind is the 'from' direction (north wind from north); but wind barb arrows often show 'to'—watch the distinction when reading charts.
